The issue is clear. The new 1.5.0 image is being rejected by a PodSecurity admission policy set to "restricted:latest" on the `documents` namespace. The new pod template (presumably changed in 1.5.0) violates several PodSecurity requirements:

1. `allowPrivilegeEscalation != false` — must set `securityContext.allowPrivilegeEscalation=false`
2. Unrestricted capabilities — must set `securityContext.capabilities.drop=["ALL"]`
3. `runAsNonRoot != true` — must set `securityContext.runAsNonRoot=true`
4. Missing `seccompProfile` — needs to be set to `RuntimeDefault` or `Localhost`

The 1.4.2 pods are still running simply because Kubernetes never evicted them; the rollout just couldn't spin up new ones. I should look into the PodSecurity admission docs so I can cite this accurately.
